# External dependencies

## Reviewed usage

- **Required schema-validation dependency**. jsonschema 4.26.0 and referencing 0.37.0 are required for pipeline schema validation and offline reference resolution. Missing schema-validation dependencies fail explicitly. Requirements belong in an ignored virtual environment, not version control. ([`requirements.txt:1`](../../../requirements.txt#L1), [`lit_pattern/common.py:12`](../../../lit_pattern/common.py#L12), [`.gitignore:6`](../../../.gitignore#L6), [`requirements.txt:2`](../../../requirements.txt#L2))
- **Standard-library tooling**. The existing codebook generator uses argparse, csv, hashlib, sys, and pathlib from the standard library. unittest and subprocess drive conformance tests. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:6`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L6), [`tests/test_annotations.py:5`](../../../tests/test_annotations.py#L5), [`tests/test_normalise.py:10`](../../../tests/test_normalise.py#L10))
- **Planned integrations**. SQLite remains a future option; there is no SQL persistence. Annotation-platform applications and other analytical packages remain candidates, without implemented adapters or agreement analysis. ([`REPO_CONTRACT.md:91`](../../../REPO_CONTRACT.md#L91), [`docs/00_control/002_repo_status.md:58`](../../00_control/002_repo_status.md#L58), [`docs/80_reference/804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md:43`](../804_tooling_and_corpus_requirements.md#L43))
- **Publication versus runtime**. GitHub publication is recorded in repository status. The file pipeline itself has no hosted API or model dependency and only uses local schema references. ([`docs/00_control/002_repo_status.md:32`](../../00_control/002_repo_status.md#L32), [`lit_pattern/validate.py:26`](../../../lit_pattern/validate.py#L26), [`docs/30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md:170`](../../30_design/304_annotation_file_contract.md#L170))
